description: This file defines the Array1D class which encapsulates a one-dimensional array of doubles with validation to ensure the array is sorted. It includes methods for creating an array based on external Field input, and for finding an index based on a value.

classes.name: Array1D
classes.description: Represents a sorted one-dimensional array of doubles with methods for creation and search.

methods.name: Array1D
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the array and validates sorting order.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create an Array1D instance with a specified size, potentially based on external Field specification.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the array where the value fits, based on the comparison with array elements.
